name: US Census Bureau data and publications
goodFor: Official US population, income, housing and demographic data for sociology and geography examples.

evidence.quote: The U.S. Census Bureau publishes its data as open data, meaning it is freely available for use and re-use by the public.
Data users who create their own estimates using data from disseminated tables and other data should cite the Census Bureau as the source of the original data only.

notes: Link only. The Bureau's own policy pages say its data is open and free to re-use and ask for citation, but none of the pages read (Policies, Open Government, Citing our Data, Privacy) says the content is public domain or gives a licence, and none says what is excepted (third-party pictures, restricted-use data). The agency's Terms page returned only a notice about inappropriate terms. The candidate's claim of public domain therefore rests on US law in general, which the us-government record covers per item. Recheck if the Bureau publishes a copyright statement.
